title: A Name on the Stone
victim: Itachi Uchiha, rogue ninja of the Akatsuki
teaser: In the night the sensors sensed an intruder by Konoha's western wall, and the village was sealed inside a barrier: nobody can leave unnoticed. At 01:40 a patrol found Itachi Uchiha, a rogue from the Bingo Book, dead by the Memorial Stone. A chisel lay beside him, and among the names of the Leaf's fallen heroes a new one had appeared, still covered in stone dust: "Itachi Uchiha". Traitors aren't written there. Whoever carved the name knew more about Itachi than anyone. They're still here.

habits.label: Loves ramen
habits.habit: Eats ramen at Ichiraku every evening and leaves smelling of broth
clues: A pair of disposable chopsticks in an Ichiraku paper sleeve was dropped by the stone. The culprit loves ramen.
The chisel handle smells of pork broth, as if held with greasy fingers. The culprit loves ramen.

habits.label: Senbon between the teeth
habits.habit: Always has a senbon needle between their teeth, the way others chew a blade of grass
clues: A senbon with tooth marks lies in the grass by the stone. The culprit holds a senbon between their teeth.
A patrolman saw a figure at the training ground gate with a thin needle sticking out of its mouth. The culprit holds a senbon between their teeth.

habits.label: Drinks expired milk
habits.habit: Drinks milk without checking the date and insists it's healthier that way
clues: An empty milk bottle a week past its date lies by the stone. The culprit drinks expired milk.
Itachi's cloak smells of sour milk, as if some was dripped on it. The culprit drinks expired milk.

habits.label: Forehead protector on the neck
habits.habit: Ties their forehead protector round their neck, not their forehead
clues: The Memorial Stone has a fresh scratch at chest height: someone leaned over and the plate of a protector worn on the neck scraped the stone. The culprit wears their protector on their neck.
A patrolman saw a silhouette at the training ground gate with a metal plate glinting at its neck. The culprit wears their protector on their neck.

habits.label: Wears training weights
habits.habit: Never takes the weights off their legs, even on holidays
clues: The footprints by the stone are small but deep, like a person with weights on their legs. The culprit wears training weights.
A lead plate from a training weight with a torn strap lies under the training post. The culprit wears training weights.

habits.label: Flower in the hair
habits.habit: Every morning weaves a fresh flower from the flower shop into their hair
clues: An iris with a broken stem lies by the stone, as if it fell out of someone's hair. People bring white chrysanthemums for the fallen, never irises. The culprit wears a flower in their hair.
A folder from the Hokage's office smells of iris, though no flowers are kept in the office. The culprit wears a flower in their hair.

habits.label: Frog purse
habits.habit: Keeps their money in a plump purse shaped like a green frog
clues: A five-ryo coin and a button eye from a frog purse lie in the grass by the stone. The culprit has a frog purse.
The ramen shop owner remembers that in the night someone paid in small change from a frog purse and went straight off towards the training ground. The culprit has a frog purse.

habits.label: Battle fan on the back
habits.habit: Carries a huge battle fan on their back
clues: The grass round the stone is flattened in a neat semicircle, as if by a powerful sweep of a fan. The culprit carries a battle fan.
A broken rib from a large fan was found by the training post. The culprit carries a battle fan.

habits.label: Keeps a messenger hawk
habits.habit: Sends letters by a tame hawk and feeds it by hand
clues: A speckled hawk feather and scraps of raw meat lie by the stone. The culprit keeps a messenger hawk.
Before dawn a messenger hawk with no letter circled over the training ground, then flew off towards the residential districts. The culprit keeps a messenger hawk.

habits.label: Insects in the sleeves
habits.habit: Insects live in their sleeves and sometimes crawl out
clues: Little black beetles that don't live in Konoha are crawling on the stone. The culprit has insects in their sleeves.
A barrier team sensor felt a swarm of tiny chakra sparks on the training ground in the night, as insects give off. The culprit has insects in their sleeves.

habits.label: Gourd of sand
habits.habit: Carries a large gourd full of sand on their back
clues: Fine reddish sand that isn't found in Konoha is scattered by the stone. The culprit carries a gourd of sand.
There's a round dent in the grass by the post from something heavy, with grains of sand around it. The culprit carries a gourd of sand.

habits.label: Painted face
habits.habit: Paints purple stripes on their face with war paint
clues: A folder from the Hokage's office has a purple fingerprint on it. It's face war paint. The culprit paints their face.
There's a smudged purple mark on the stone, as if someone pressed a cheek to it. The culprit paints their face.

habits.label: Big sword on the back
habits.habit: Carries a sword almost as tall as they are on their back
clues: The training post has a fresh notch at shoulder height: that's how a sword on someone's back catches it when they turn. The culprit carries a big sword.
A patrolman saw a silhouette by the training ground with a long hilt over its shoulder. The culprit carries a big sword.

habits.label: Takes soldier pills
habits.habit: Swallows a chakra soldier pill before any job
clues: A crushed soldier pill with a bitter herbal smell lies by the stone. The culprit takes soldier pills.
An empty paper packet from the hospital pharmacy marked "Pills, 10" lies in the grass. The culprit takes soldier pills.

habits.label: Wears orange
habits.habit: Goes about in a bright orange jacket you can see a mile off
clues: A patrolman saw something bright orange vault over the training ground fence. The culprit wears orange.
An orange jacket zip pull lies in the grass by the stone. The culprit wears orange.

habits.label: Singed sleeves
habits.habit: Sleeves always singed from practising fire techniques
clues: There's a palm-sized black scorch on the grass by the stone, as if someone absent-mindedly breathed out fire. The culprit wears singed clothes.
The chisel handle has soot on it that smells of burnt cloth. The culprit wears singed clothes.

strong: The training post next to the stone was wrenched out of the ground and thrown three paces away. It can't be shifted without enormous strength. The culprit is strong in taijutsu.
Itachi was carried from the posts to the stone: the soft earth shows deep prints of only one person. The culprit is strong in taijutsu.
quiet: Bells on wires still hang along the edge of the training ground, an old alarm for genin. Not one rang. The culprit can sneak up unnoticed.
The dew on the grass by the path hasn't been disturbed: someone walked to the stone barely touching the ground. The culprit can sneak up unnoticed.
tools: Three shuriken are driven into the training post one inside another at a single point. Someone was waiting for Itachi and throwing in the dark out of boredom. The culprit is a master with weapons.
The chisel was held in a reverse grip, like a kunai, and the letters came out even, without a single stray notch. The culprit is a master with weapons.
medic: The blow landed precisely on the chakra point by the heart, with almost nothing visible outside. Only someone who knows where to strike hits like that. The culprit knows medicine and poisons.
Itachi didn't resist: his lips have a bitter coating of paralysing poison brewed from marsh herbs. The culprit knows medicine and poisons.
keys: At night the gates of Training Ground Three are closed with a seal that only the chakra of authorised people can lift. The seal was lifted, not broken. The culprit had clearance.
The file on the Uchiha clan's destruction was kept under guard in the Hokage's office, yet it was found by the stone next to Itachi. The guards saw no stranger. The culprit had clearance.
safe: A paper seal that turns eyes away is stuck to the back of the stone: patrolmen walked past twice and noticed nothing. The culprit knows sealing techniques.
There's a paper seal on Itachi's wrist that suppresses chakra. The Sharingan is useless with a seal like that. The culprit knows sealing techniques.
sched: It all happened in the twenty minutes when the barrier team changes shifts at the western wall. The culprit knows the village routine.

Itachi was summoned to the stone by a note for 01:30, exactly when ANBU leave the training ground for their night report. Only a small circle knows that routine. The culprit knows the village routine.
tech: The ramen shop owner is sure one customer sat at the counter until two in the morning. But at 01:35 he vanished with a pop and a puff of smoke: it was a shadow clone. The culprit is strong in ninjutsu.

A patrolman let a medical ninja from the hospital through to the training ground, but the hospital confirms that ninja never left the patients all night. Someone got through wearing another's face. The culprit is strong in ninjutsu.
cash: The guard at the training ground gate left his post for half an hour, and in the morning paid for drinks with crisp new ryo notes. Somebody paid him. The culprit has ryo to spare.
Ichiraku's book records a big bill: yesterday someone treated the whole night patrol, and the patrol stayed an hour longer than usual. The culprit has ryo to spare.
passages: An old passage leads from the shelter in the Hokage Rock to the training ground, and only a handful of people know about it. Its grille is open, and there are fresh footprints on the steps. The culprit knows Konoha's secret ways.
Someone got to the training ground not by the streets but over the rooftops along the wall, where the patrol never looks. The culprit knows Konoha's secret ways.
